name: php2shell-blue-team-audit
description: Blue-team inventory of CT-discovered hostnames, HTTP status, and disclosed PHP versions

scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs => { const { execFileSync } = await import('node:child_process'); for (const dir of ['src', 'public', 'test']) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { if (f.endsWith('.js')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', dir + '/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); } } const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/advisories.json', 'utf8')); if (pkg.version !== lock.version || pkg.version !== lock.packages[''].version) throw new Error('package.json and package-lock.json versions differ'); })"
